Where You Are Right Now

Three problems holding Elite Talent Recruiting back.

01
🔄
Feast-or-Famine Cycle
Revenue comes in waves. When delivery is busy, BD stops. When BD picks back up, delivery suffers. There is no consistent pipeline engine running in the background.
02
🔗
Connection Limit Ceiling
LinkedIn caps weekly connections at 100–200. If that's your primary BD channel, you're capped before you even start. Volume without infrastructure leads nowhere.
03
🏢
No Internal TA Team
Most funded SaaS companies in your market have no dedicated recruiter or talent acquisition team. When headcount pressure hits, they scramble — and the agencies already in front of them win every time.
Your Biggest Blocker
Your biggest blocker is not effort. It's the absence of an engine.

The Playbooks

Three intent triggers. Three automated sequences.

01
New Leader Signal
New Leader at a Funded SaaS
Detects when a new VP Sales, CRO, or CMO joins a funded SaaS company. Triggers outreach before they rebuild their team.
→ Pull leadership change signals
→ Filter VP Sales / CRO / CMO
→ Enrich + trigger sequence
02
Open Role Signal
Active Pre/Post-Sales Hiring
Monitors funded SaaS companies actively posting pre-sales or post-sales roles. Outreach lands when hiring intent is confirmed.
→ Pull LinkedIn Jobs daily
→ Filter SaaS in North America
→ Enrich hiring manager + trigger
03
No Internal TA Signal
No Internal TA Targeting
Identifies funded SaaS companies with no dedicated recruiter or TA team. Deploys targeted sequences when they post roles.
→ Filter: no HR/TA on LinkedIn
→ Cross-reference open role signal
→ Trigger personalised outreach
